core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gawdat is an Arabic-origin name meaning “To be excellent, generous”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: No verified lexical identification was established for Gawdat. Gawdat/Gawdat is an Egyptian spelling of Arabic جودت (Jawdat), a verbal-noun form from the root ج و د (j-w-d) 'to be excellent, generous'. It means 'excellence, goodness, generosity'. The source gave a string containing a Devanagari/Arabic mixture (غودات) and glossed it 'protector' (a different root, ح ف ظ), both of which were corrected. The identification is probable rather than certain. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
